dct_title_s: Vietnam Typhoon Yagi: Damage Proxy Maps, Sep 2024
dct_description_sm: # Vietnam Typhoon Yagi: Damage Proxy Maps, Sep 2024 The **Earth Observatory of Singapore – Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS)** produced these damage proxy maps for Vietnam Typhoon Yagi (Sep 2024) from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite images. Each map is a separate ZIP below with its GeoTIFF, a KMZ for Google Earth, the PNG figures and a text file describing how it was made and how to read it. ## Maps in this dataset - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Vietnam, Typhoon Yagi, 10 Sep 2024, v0.9 wbd** (superseded) - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Vietnam, Typhoon Yagi, 10 Sep 2024, v0.9 ** **More map details and files:** **More map details and files:** **Legal Disclaimer:** **Credits:** Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS), Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2024)
